exact: regulation of Wnt receptor signaling pathway, calcium modulating pathway
regulation of Wnt-activated signaling pathway, calcium modulating pathway

definition: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of the series of molecular signals initiated by binding of a Wnt protein to a receptor on the surface of the target cell where activated receptors leads to an increase in intracellular calcium and activation of protein kinase C (PKC).
label: regulation of Wnt signaling pathway, calcium modulating pathway
